sn11.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn11.1:2.2: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo suvīraṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi.
sn11.1:2.3: ete tāta suvīra, asurā deve abhiyanti.
sn11.1:2.5: vaṃ bhaddaṃ tavāti kho bhikkhave suvīro devaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā pamādaṃ āpādesi.
sn11.1:2.6: dutiyampi kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo suvīraṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi:
sn11.1:2.7: ete tāta suvīra, asurā deve abhiyanti.
sn11.1:2.9: evaṃ bhaddaṃ tavāti kho bhikkhave suvīro devaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā dutiyampi pamādaṃ āpādesi.
sn11.1:2.10: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo suvīraṃ devaputtaṃ āmantesi:
sn11.1:2.11: ete tāta suvīra, asurā deve abhiyanti.
sn11.1:2.13: evaṃ bhaddaṃ tavāti kho bhikkhave suvīro devaputto sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā tatiyampi pamādaṃ āpādesi.
sn11.1:2.14: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo suvīraṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
sn11.1:8.1: so hi nāma bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo sakaṃ puññaphalaṃ upajīvamāno devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kārento uṭṭhānaviriyassa vaṇṇavādī bhavissati.
sn11.1:8.2: idha kho taṃ bhikkhave sobhetha, yaṃ tumhe evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajitā samānā uṭṭhaheyyātha ghaṭeyyātha vāyameyyātha appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
